{{Quote|You ordered the cream of fleek eel, right? Careful, hon, the plate's hot. And the fleek eels bite.|FLO|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''FLO''', also known as '''WA-7''', was an antique [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 waitress droid]] owned by [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the owner of [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While she worked at the diner, she feuded with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] head waitress [[Hermione Bagwa/Legends|Hermione Bagwa]] over getting more tips and mastery of the customer areas. At some point, FLO turned her beloved dishwasher at the diner into spare parts after it gossiped about her to the other kitchen appliances. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], FLO served Jettster and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] after the latter stopped at the diner to ask about a [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|saberdart]] found during the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempted assassination]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].

==Biography==
===Waitress feud===
[[File:Dex in the kitchen.png|thumb|left|300px|FLO was accquired by Dexter Jettxter (pictured)]]
A used,<ref name="NewGuide" /> antique<ref name="CATCW" /> WA-7 waitress droid,<ref name="CSWE" /> FLO was purchased by [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] on the<ref name="CATCW" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &#x2014; Based on corresponding data for [[Subterrel system/Legends|Subterrel system]]</ref> [[Subterrel/Legends|Subterrel]].<ref name="CATCW" /> Jettster's possession of FLO inspired him to go into the restaurant business, and he eventually owned [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CATCW" /> some point during or after [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DinerDate">{{FactFile|54|COR 23-26|Coruscant – Dex's Diner}} states that [[Didi Oddo]] gave up his café four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Therefore, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] must have owned the building some point during or after that year.</ref>

FLO spent a lot of her [[Time/Legends|time]] trying to prove to Jettster that she was a better waitress than<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] head waitress<ref name="FF60" /> [[Hermione Bagwa/Legends|Hermione Bagwa]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The two feuded with each other<ref name="FF60" /> every [[Local day/Legends|day]],<ref name="DB-Bagwa, Hermione" /> competing with each other over getting more tips<ref name="CATCW" /> and getting mastery over the customer areas of the diner.<ref name="FF60" /> There, she loved and flirted with a dishwasher unit,<ref name="FF64" /> though it was turned into spare parts by FLO after it gossiped about her to the other appliances in the diner. The components of the dishwasher were used to create the [[circuit cider]] served at the diner.<ref name="Dining">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>

===Dining Jedi=== 
[[File:Off_she_rolls.png|right|thumb|350px|FLO rolls away after serving Dexter Jettster and Obi-Wan Kenobi]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the diner seeking out his friend Jettster to help him identify a [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|saberdart]] found during the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempted assassination]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. FLO was cleaning the diner booths when Kenobi entered and was initially unhelpful when the Jedi asked for the owner. After Kenobi told her that he was not in trouble and the matters were personal, FLO gave him an evaluating look then called out for Jettster, identifying Kenobi as a Jedi while doing so.<ref name="JN">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' junior novelization]]</ref> FLO made her way to diner bar and asked the Jedi if he wanted some [[Ardees/Legends|Jawa juice]], which he yes to. After Jettster sat at the booth, she rolled over and gave Kenobi his juice and Jettster a drink.<ref name="EpisodeII">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Two years later in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date2">As [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] is the apprentice of [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'' must take place between the episodes ''[[Monster]]'' and "[[Witches of the Mist]]" of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 48]]'' dates the events of "Monster" and "Witches of the Mist" to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> FLO was working at the diner, holding a tray with a steaming consumable when Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] visited looking for the [[Swooper/Legends|swoop biker]] [[Gizman]].<ref name="StrangeAllies">''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
===FLO versus Hermione===
[[File:Hermione Bagwa - new databank.png|thumb|left|250px|Hermione Bagwa, FLO's rival]]
Even after years of catering, the efficient FLO was still functional and capable, though her spirited character and attitude programming may have suffered deterioration. She disliked low tippers,<ref name="Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook]]''</ref> treated the regulars of Dex's Diner with coldness, disdain,<ref name="FF64" /> and officious precision.<ref name="DB" /> Her attitude with the customers and her treatment of Hermione Bagwa were a mystery, though some had always said she was officious and cantankerous. WA-7 droids were usually programmed with subservient attitudes,<ref name="FF64" /> but FLO had a sassy attitude and a problem with authority.<ref name="FF60">{{FactFile|60|BAG 1-4|Hermione Bagwa}}</ref> This tone indicated that someone was changing her programming.<ref name="FF64" />

FLO was barely tolerant of Jettster and felt herself equal to him, though the diner owner thought she added character to his diner.<ref name="FF64" /> The WA-7 droid had waged war and started<ref name="FF60" /> an apparent battle of supremacy with Bagwa,<ref name="FF64" /> spending most of her time trying to prove to Jettster she was better than the Human.<ref name="CSWE" /> FLO was the only thing Bagwa did not like about working at the diner, and she appeared to be jealous of the woman. The bossy droid did not take kindly to the inexperienced and organic presence of the head waitress<ref name="FF60" /> and treated her with hostility.<ref name="FF64" /> The pair constantly feuded with each other<ref name="FF60" /> each day<ref name="DB-Bagwa, Hermione" /> over mastery of the diner's customer areas,<ref name="FF60" /> and competed over who could get the most tips,<ref name="CATCW" /> with Bagwa leaving hidden traps around the diner and FLO enjoying nothing more than running over Bagwa's toes with her wheel, causing her to wear heavy-heeled boots.<ref name="FF64" /> They viewed each other as their subordinates in the hierarchy of the diner, leading to colorful [[Language/Legends|words]] exchanged between the two, which customers found delightful.<ref name="NewGuide" /> 

Though she did not have positive interactions with others in the diner, there was one in the diner whom FLO softened to and loved, the humble dishwashing unit. She flirted with it<ref name="FF64" /> shamelessly<ref name="DB" /> and outrageously. It was possible that her misplaced affection for the unit was a result of her glitches that caused her other behaviors, as she was meant to flirt only with the diner's customers. As far as FLO was concerned, the only thing right about the diner was her, and perhaps the dishwasher as well.<ref name="FF64" />

===One-wheeled waitress===
[[File:WA7WaitressProfile-FF64.png|thumb|right|150px|FLO]]
FLO was streamlined, sleek, and built to have a look resembling a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|droid|wa7|FLO (WA-7)}}</ref> The sharp-eyed, ambidextrous<ref name="CATCW" /> service droid stood at 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="NewGuide" /> and had feminine programming.<ref name="CSWE" /> She had a shiny [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] frame,<ref name="FF64" /> [[Color/Legends|yellow]] sensors<ref name="CSWE" /> and a dark-red livery battered and worn over the years from catering. Her head housed her main sensors and was covered with a<ref name="FF64" /> finned<ref name="NewGuide" /> metal bonnet. FLO's charming character came from her main processor, housed in her upper body.<ref name="FF64" /> An order transmitter,<ref name="NewGuide" /> a device that could relay customer orders from the dining area to the kitchen, was also located here.<ref name="FF64" /> On the left half of her chest was an<ref name="NewGuide" /> imprinted [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]<ref name="CATCW" /> nametag reading "FLO."<ref name="NewGuide" /> Connected to her body were two slim and graceful limbs, not meant for strength or heavy labor.<ref name="FF64" />

A bending central joint was contained in FLO's slim waist. Lower down her body was a decorative,<ref name="FF64" /> metallic<ref name="DB" /> dark-red skirt that protected a motor unit and a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] generator.<ref name="FF64" /> Even lower down inside the body was gyro-balance circuitry that kept FLO perfectly upright.<ref name="NewGuide" /> The motor unit powered a singular<ref name="FF64" /> drive wheel,<ref name="NewGuide" /> edged in high-grip polymer that allowed FLO to gain speed and perform nifty maneuvers around the diner's kitchen. Just above the wheel were two repulsor stabilizers and old-fashioned suspension units. The stabilizers could assist her motor and help give FLO more speed, though she never reached her top speed within the diner.<ref name="FF64" />

==Behind the scenes==
FLO was created for<ref name="DB" /> the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="EpisodeII" /> which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The character was based on an illustration by Visual Effects Concept Illustrator [[Warren Fu]] and done through computer-animation. FLO was made to replace Hermione Bagwa, portrayed by actor [[Susie Porter]], and was a late addition to the film.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> Porter delivered the dialogue seen in the film both for Bagwa and FLO, but it was only FLO who ended up with all the lines in the final film script.<ref name="DB-Bagwa, Hermione">{{DB|character|hermionebagwa|Bagwa, Hermione}}</ref> The name FLO is a reference to the character Florence "Flo" Castleberry from the 1970s sitcom ''[[Wikipedia:Alice (American TV series)|Alice]]'', based on the 1974 film ''[[Wikipedia:Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore|Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore]]'', which was directed by [[George Lucas]]' friend [[Wikipedia:Martin Scorsese|Martin Scorsese]].<ref>{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1487499338259435523|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=And yes, Wanda's name tag says FLO, which is a nod to Flo from 'Alice,' which itself is an adaptation / spin-off of a Martin Scorsese film, Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore, and George and Marty are friends, so it's references within references.|archivedate=20220303201616}}</ref>

Prior to her film appearance, she first appeared in the film's [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] written by [[R. A. Salvatore]],<ref name="Novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> and in its [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] written by [[Patricia C. Wrede]].<ref name="JN" /> Both books were released on [[April 23]], 2002.<ref name="Cargo Bay">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=26771|text=R.A. Salvatore}}</ref><ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/release/publish/news20020215.html|text=Book Preview: Junior Novelization}}</ref>

FLO is a non-playable character in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''. She only rolls around the main room, and can be attacked, but has infinite health.
